details: Stronger-than-expected US employment data for August has significantly increased market expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike at its upcoming September 15-16 meeting, with probabilities now hovering around 60%. This has driven 10-year Treasury yields near 4.8%, creating a "risk-off" sentiment that has contributed to a decline in Bitcoin and the broader cryptocurrency market. Higher rates make yield-bearing investments more attractive, reducing the appeal of speculative assets like crypto.
title: Strong US Jobs Data Intensifies Fed Rate Hike Expectations, Pressuring Crypto

details: Crude oil prices are nearing $100 per barrel, with US crude topping $92, driven by escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly around the Strait of Hormuz. This surge in oil prices is intensifying inflation concerns globally, adding pressure on central banks to maintain or even increase interest rates. Such an environment typically dampens investor appetite for risk assets, including Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
title: Oil Prices Approach $100 Amid Geopolitical Tensions, Fueling Inflation Worries

details: Despite ongoing geopolitical challenges and high energy prices, the global economy is demonstrating unusual strength, propelled by significant AI investment, robust corporate spending, and increased defense expenditure. While positive for overall growth, this sustained economic momentum could limit central banks' ability to ease monetary policy, potentially leading to prolonged higher interest rates and increased borrowing costs, which can negatively impact asset valuations, including those in the crypto market.
title: Robust Global Economic Growth May Force Central Banks to Maintain Tight Policy
